about: Adapter of the ui-iteration-loop for the agenticspec docs site (website/, built into website/build and served by docusaurus serve under /agenticspec/). The fast loop is website/e2e, run by task check:site; the rounds are ux/site/rounds/S-nn.
search_note: the site has no search box (no search plugin in website/docusaurus.config.ts); the KPI catalogue's own search field is a control of that page, not an always-visible element
completion: the scenario's target element is 100 % inside the viewport, not covered at its centre, and shows the scenario's truth; a target taller than the viewport counts as in view when its top is (S-02, T4)
screen_only_policy: deterministic code, no model: website/e2e/bot.ts; the route of each task is the steps of its card, each a visible control found by role and name

contract_notes.pre: a code block (pre) may scroll sideways in its box; every other element may not
contract_notes.below_997: the theme toggle and the sidebar sit in the collapsed menu below 997 px wide (Docusaurus), so they are always-visible only from 997 px

metric_notes.screen_only.steers: always 0: with no guidance cue there is no cue to steer back
metric_notes.layout_shift.score: the sum of the layout shifts of every page the run opened, page loads included
metric_notes.reading_load: words of visible text in the viewport at each look
metric_notes.aborted_runs: a run that stops before its target reports no reading load, glance or time to act (null), and stays out of the metric tables and sums (S-02, T5)

dropped.L0: no guidance cue, so no engine scenario and no gate 6
dropped.L1: the site has no unit tests of its components yet
